result.summary: The interface displays minor layout and content issues regarding element clipping and text truncation.

issues.description: The promotional banner's right edge appears cut off without consistent padding or rounded corners.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the banner width or padding to align with the screen's margins.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the horizontal carousel are truncated, reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Implement multi-line text or adjust card sizing to accommodate longer titles.

issues.description: Category tags on the right are clipped, which might be mistaken for a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade effect or better spacing to clearly indicate horizontal scrolling.
